paper_title: First Constraints on Nuclear Coupling of Axionlike Particles from the Binary Neutron Star Gravitational Wave Event GW170817
notes: Constraint from GW170817 BNS inspiral on axions coupling to nuclear matter. Primary result is on the f_a - m_a plane (Fig. 1: Log10[GeV/f_a] vs Log10[m_a/eV]), so classified as AxionMass rather than a g_an coupling (paper does not express results as g_an). Excluded band: 1.6e16 GeV < f_a < 1e18 GeV for m_a <= 1e-11 eV, at 3 sigma confidence (closest allowed CL flag 0.95). Emitted line traces the lower/weakest f_a exclusion boundary (1.6e16 GeV) which extends to the massless limit. Upper cutoff f_a~1e18 GeV set by NS phase-transition condition.
